items.title: Dell Sinks 16% in a Week on Intel’s PC Warning. Its CFO Already Saw “Minus Double Digit”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysDell Technologies (DELL) stock fell approximately 16% from October 26 to November 2, closing near $393 as higher memory costs and weakening PC demand pressured shares. Intel (INTC) projected PC unit declines of approximately 12% in 2026 and 10% in 2027, raising concerns about a prolonged downturn.
